generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

In the case of death of a contractor after executing / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of work.
The amount put to tender is Exclusive of GST and the tenderer should quote Without GST
During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any certification/ information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submitting their tenders.
If any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Any Modification/ corrections will be published in the KPP -portal. The bidders are advised to visit the KPP portal web site regularly.
FOR MORE CONDITIONS AND CRITERIAL REFER UPLOADED BID DOCUMENT

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under:Assessed available tender capacity is equal to (A X N X 2.5 Minus B) where,A is equal to Maximum value of Civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years at 2025-26 price level (updated to the Financial year in which the tender is invited) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N is equal to Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited.B is equal to Value, at 2026-27 price level (updated to the Financial year in which the tender is invited) of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1 years (12 Months) (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited).

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Maintenance of of Hydraulic power packs (7-16) to spillway crest Gates of Almatti Dam

itemList.description: Servicing of Power pack including External cleaning of complete system, Removal of each valve/components mounted on PU, Visual inspection of M block inside cavities, Replace the recommended spares (coils/PIC/mounting seal kits), After cleaning local flushing to be done for block by using portable flushing unit/high pressure jet, Tank inspection /Painting, replacement of all seals/ ‘O’ rings, Painting of PU, Commissioning of PU etc including cost of all materials, machinery, labour transportation complete with all leads and lifts as directed by Engineer in charge.

Supply and installation of recommended spares for one power pack unit such as check valves No’s, pressure switches, pressure gauge isolator, pressure gauge, return line filter, element, hand pumpm13cc double stroke, dc valve, flow control valve, sequence valve, pocv, pressure relief valve, manual operation dc valve, throttle check valve, Inspection Cover seal, Seal & O rings etc including cost of all materials, machinery, labour transportation complete with all leads and lifts as directed by Engineer in charge.
